title: Jobs
lead: Every job from every user: what it cost and where it stands.

running.label: Running now
running.sub: Jobs in progress at this moment

empty.text: No jobs match your search or filter.

reason.clips-failed: Some clips could not be made
reason.content-rule: The images or text of this job break our content rules, so it was stopped. It cannot be continued.
reason.submission-unknown: A request to the video provider got no clear answer: it may or may not exist there. Look in the provider's task list. If it is not there, settle it here, then retry the job.

detail.provider-credits: The video provider has no credits left. Top up the provider account, then retry the job. The finished parts are kept.
detail.provider-cap: Our spending limit was reached (daily or per job). Raise it in the worker settings or wait for the next UTC day, then retry.
detail.provider-refused: The provider refused a request (rate limit or a rejected input). Retry later; if it repeats, look at the job's stop.json.
detail.provider-setup: The provider key is missing or not accepted, or the spending limits are not set (VC_PROVIDER_DAILY_CAP, VC_PROVIDER_JOB_CAP). Fix the worker's settings, then retry.
detail.upload-failed: A product photo could not be uploaded to the provider. Retry; if it repeats, check the photo.
detail.no-products: The sample was started with no product photo.

detail.title: Job
detail.label: Job details
detail.note: The customer is not charged. The finished parts stay saved. A retry runs only the missing part.

problem.textWrong: Text is wrong or cut off
problem.notMe: This is not me / no permission (person swap)

review.title: Photo review
review.lead: Person-swap jobs wait here until an admin has looked at their photos. The one that waits longest is first.
review.list: Jobs that wait for the look
review.leftHours: Refused by itself in {hours} h {minutes} min
review.gone: This photo can no longer be shown.
review.decided: Already decided: the photo is not shown any more.

rejectDialog.title: Reject these photos?
rejectDialog.body: The job is closed and nothing is generated. All its credits go back, the photos are deleted now and the customer gets an email. This cannot be undone.

review.approved: Approved: the job of {email} takes its place in the line.
review.rejected: Rejected: the credits of {email} are back and the photos are deleted.
review.already: This job already had its answer on {date}. Nothing was changed.
review.failed: The answer did not go through. Nothing was changed.

empty.title: No photos wait for a look
empty.on: A person-swap job appears here as soon as a customer starts one.
empty.off: The look at photos is switched off in Settings: person-swap jobs start without it.
